topic.label: Data Visualization and ML Datasets
topic.desc: Data Visualization and ML Datasets: Exploration and Visualisation, Data Visualization and Communication and Datasets for Machine Learning.

concepts.label: Exploration and Visualisation
concepts.desc: Looking at data to learn from it: profiling, summaries, charts that tell the truth and sharing findings.

concepts.label: Datasets for Machine Learning
concepts.desc: Preparing data for models: labelling, splits, leakage, class balance, versioning and dataset documentation.

concepts.label: Data Visualization and Communication
concepts.desc: Turning analyses into honest charts, dashboards and narratives that decision makers can read correctly.

skills.label: Honest Chart Designer
skills.desc: Chooses a chart for the question, sets axes and scales that do not mislead and writes the title as the finding.

skills.label: Data Profiler
skills.desc: Profiles columns for types, ranges, missing values and outliers and lists the first questions the profile raises.

skills.label: Insight Reporter
skills.desc: Writes up a finding with the number, the comparison, the caveats and what decision it should or should not drive.

skills.label: Dataset Card Writer
skills.desc: Documents a dataset's source, collection method, labelling process, licence, balance and known gaps in one page.

skills.label: Labeling Guide Designer
skills.desc: Writes labelling instructions with examples and edge cases and measures how often two labellers agree.

skills.label: Split and Leakage Checker
skills.desc: Builds train, validation and test splits by the right unit and checks for duplicates and future information crossing them.

skills.label: Chart Designer
skills.desc: Chooses chart forms and visual encodings for a dataset and checks that axes, scales and colors do not distort the data.

skills.label: Dashboard Builder
skills.desc: Assembles metric dashboards from warehouse queries and checks every tile against its source query.

skills.label: Exploratory Data Analyst
skills.desc: Profiles distributions, correlations and anomalies in a new dataset and checks findings against summary statistics.
